title: Bright Star
paragraphs: Ziv-syndicated newspaper comedy-drama centered on Hillsdale Morning Star editor Susan Armstrong and reporter George Harvey. The frozen container preserves 31 numbered broadcasts from the 52-program run plus five OTRR reference tracks; all 31 surviving broadcast dates are recovered additively from specialist collection metadata.
GRH documents the program through Ziv syndicated run (October 23, 1952 to October 15, 1953).
Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Fred MacMurray (performer on 31 recordings) and Irene Dunne (performer on 31 recordings).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include newspaper newsroom and local journalism, Susan and George romantic tension, small-town community life, performance, culture and publicity, family, matchmaking and old relationships, and swindles, crime and investigative reporting.

GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including Ziv transcription syndication, Hollywood stars in syndicated radio, Newspaper comedy-drama, and Partial survival of a 52-program run.
